name: Lever Postings
tagline: Public job postings API for company career pages and widgets
description: Lever Postings is a public, unauthenticated REST API that exposes a company's published job openings for career pages, job widgets, and third-party job boards. Developers fetch listings by company site slug, with optional filters for team, location, commitment, and department; responses include job metadata, apply URLs, and rich description content.

auth.details: No authentication required for public postings. Company site slug in the URL path identifies the employer. API key only needed for Lever's private/authenticated APIs, not this public postings endpoint.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No official free-tier allowance or GET usage cap is published. Application POST requests are limited to 2 per second.

rate_limits: Application POST requests are limited to 2 per second; exceeding this returns HTTP 429. Lever may change the limit without warning. No numeric limit is documented for listing GET requests.
use_cases: list open jobs for a company career page
filter postings by team location or department
embed a job widget with live Lever openings
sync published roles into an external job board
fetch a single job posting by ID for a detail page
